verdicts.explanation: The abstract gives 14 mS cm−1 for amorphous Li3ScCl6 as an estimated room-temperature value from this paper's MD and rescaling, and Section 3.1 gives Ea = 0.182 ± 0.018 eV for Li3ScCl6. Origin is computational and the temperature is stated only as room temperature, so null is correct.

The abstract states an estimated room-temperature conductivity of 7.7 mS cm−1 for amorphous Li3InCl6, derived in this paper from MD. No activation energy is given in the main text for Li3InCl6, so null is correct.

The introduction gives 13.5 mS cm−1 and 0.154 eV for amorphous LiNbCl6 with citations to refs 17 and 18, so literature_cited is the correct origin. The paper reports these values as prior experimental results and gives no room-temperature numeric value, so null for the temperature is correct.
